description: Deterministic harness scenarios distilled from provider, MCP, compaction, recovery and looping incidents observed in the Movarte conversations.

scenarios.incident: An explicit Gemini Notebook request must reject an unrelated MCP and continue through the requested server.
Invalid MCP arguments must identify every schema path without dispatching the malformed call, then permit a corrected call.
A read-only MCP timeout reconnects only the selected server and never replays the uncertain call.
Explicit MCP intent survives neutral continuation text and changes only when the user gives a new MCP instruction.
Selected and excluded MCP servers survive a compaction checkpoint and a journal reload.
Gateway failure and disconnect sequences retry the identical inference request across every custom provider protocol.
A provider_request returned after a durable tool result must not retry or discard that result.
Automatic compaction preserves the current request and replay context when the journal is reloaded.
A direct turn resumes only after every completed tool result is durable and keeps newly queued user guidance.
A coordinated flow pairs an uncertain mutation with one durable error result before it resumes.
Five identical results steer the model once and a sixth identical attempt pauses before executing the tool again.
A long execution with recurring confirmed mutations continues without a fixed total step limit.
The first period without material progress requires a structured objective and evidence checkpoint before another tool.
A second stagnation after an accepted checkpoint pauses durably without executing or replaying another action.
Opening a paused direct chat is passive; a new user message explicitly resumes the durable turn and preserves its queue.
